Petro Home Services

Posts no per-gallon price online. Sells a Variable plan, a Ceiling plan and the SmartPay budget plan. Source, read 2026-11-19.

Pricing model

Variable plan: the price moves with the market, with no price protection cost or termination fee. Ceiling plan: the price can fall but never passes a set limit; it needs a one-year commitment and carries a $399 early termination fee. Petro says its pricing plans have no enrollment or sign-up fees.

Price per gallon online?
No per-gallon price published. Ceiling plan early termination fee $399.
No

What its own pages say

SmartPay is a no-fee budget plan: heating oil and service plan costs are split into equal monthly payments, and the account is settled once a year with the payment adjusted up or down. Petro lists local offices in Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania and Rhode Island.

How this listing was built

Read from Petro's heating oil prices and payment plans page and its office list. Nothing on this page is estimated: where the dealer does not publish a figure, none is given. Ask for a quote at www.petro.com/oil-propane/heating-oil-prices and compare it with your state's EIA average.
